name: Wiki Editor
summary: Wiki editor CodeComponent powered by ProseMirror with a custom schema supporting paragraph, heading, callout, and table nodes. Menu bar with DropdownMenu for block types (paragraph, heading 1-3, callout). Two-column layout: page list sidebar with ScrollArea and page items with title, status badge, and last modified date, plus editor main area. AlertDialog for publish confirmation. Badge for draft/published status. useModel for wiki page listing with 5 demo pages. useHandler for publishPage action. useAppState for current page selection. Toast notifications on save/publish. Uses ProseMirror.Schema, ProseMirror.EditorState, ProseMirror.EditorView, ProseMirror.history, ProseMirror.keymap, ProseMirror.undo, ProseMirror.redo, ProseMirror.baseKeymap, ScrollArea, AlertDialog, DropdownMenu, Card, Button, Badge, Separator, and Icons from the SDK.
shortSummary: ProseMirror wiki editor with page list sidebar, block type menu, publish dialog, and draft/published status
